mapper.select: SELECT * FROM EVENT_TEMPLATE ORDER BY TEMPLATE_ID

SELECT TFR, UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE, NET_MIGRATION_RATE, LIFE_EXPECTANCY, INFANT_MORTALITY, U5_MORTALITY FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode} AND DECADE = LEAST(#{decade}, (SELECT MAX(DECADE) FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode}))

SELECT G.* FROM GAME_EVENT G JOIN EVENT_TEMPLATE T ON G.TEMPLATE_ID = T.TEMPLATE_ID WHERE G.EVENT_TYPE = 'LIFE' AND G.TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId} AND #{age} BETWEEN NVL(G.MIN_AGE, T.MIN_AGE) AND NVL(G.MAX_AGE, T.MAX_AGE) AND #{wealth} BETWEEN NVL(G.MIN_WEALTH, 1) AND NVL(G.MAX_WEALTH, 5) AND NVL(G.GENDER, #{gender}) = #{gender}
SELECT EXP_ID FROM LIFE_EXPERIENCE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
SELECT SENTENCE FROM EVENT_TEXT WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}
SELECT NAME_KO FROM COUNTRY WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode}

SELECT G.* FROM GAME_EVENT G JOIN HISTORY_EVENT H ON G.HIST_EVENT_ID = H.EVENT_ID WHERE G.EVENT_TYPE = 'HIST' AND H.COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode} AND #{year} BETWEEN H.START_YEAR AND H.END_YEAR AND #{age} BETWEEN NVL(G.MIN_AGE, 0) AND NVL(G.MAX_AGE, 110) AND NVL(G.GENDER, #{gender}) = #{gender}

SELECT C.COUNTRY_CODE, C.NAME_KO, S.GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM COUNTRY C JOIN COUNTRY_STAT S ON C.COUNTRY_CODE = S.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE C.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND C.COUNTRY_CODE != #{countryCode} AND S.DECADE = LEAST(#{decade}, (SELECT MAX(DECADE) FROM COUNTRY_STAT)) ORDER BY NVL(S.GDP_PER_CAPITA, 0) DESC
SELECT T.TRAIT_ID, E.EFFECT_VALUE FROM LIFE_TRAIT T JOIN TRAIT_LEVEL_EFFECT E ON T.TRAIT_ID = E.TRAIT_ID AND T.TRAIT_LEVEL = E.LEVEL_NO WHERE T.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
